# Legacy Heart Songs

> Legacy Heart Songs™ (Legacy Heart Songs LLC) captures a real heartbeat (or a voice) and sets it to music performed by real musicians, creating a meaningful experience for loved ones to share and a one-of-a-kind keepsake to hold and treasure. Every note is played by a person; nothing is AI-generated music. Based in the Philadelphia area, serving families by mail anywhere in the United States.

## What we make
- The HeartSong by Email — $240. The recording kit, a musician's arrangement, and two audio files delivered by email: the song, and the heartbeat on its own at its true speed.
- The HeartSong Portrait — $285. A heartbeat set to music, on a photograph in a frame to hang or place somewhere special, with a QR badge that opens the song and the heartbeat on any phone (on the back of the frame unless the customer asks for the front).
- Every price includes the recording kit. Customers who already have a recording and send it themselves pay $60 less.

## How it works
1. Tell us who, and when (the form on the site). We reply with a payment link and a timeline.
2. Capture the sound: we mail a recording kit (recorder and stethoscope microphone, postage paid both ways). In the Philadelphia area we may be able to record in person.
3. Send it back: email the recording and return the kit in the prepaid envelope.
4. A musician goes to work: we gently refine the recording for clarity while preserving the natural sound of the heartbeat, then arrange music around it.
5. It arrives: two files in your inbox, plus your keepsake if you chose one. The process takes about three to four weeks.

## Facts worth quoting
- Each HeartSong has its own QR code. Scanning it with a phone camera opens a private listening page with the song and the heartbeat, ready to play or download. No app or login; each code is random and can't be guessed.
- Real musicians, three generations of them; a person listens to every piece before it leaves.
- A heart song is a keepsake, not a medical device. It does not detect, diagnose or monitor any condition.
- Heartbeats, voices and pets' hearts can all be recorded. Fetal heartbeats recorded on a home doppler are not accepted.
- The customer owns their heartbeat. We use it only for their own order and to get better at working with this kind of sound.
- The song may be shared freely with family and friends.
